drivers.title: Newer Realtek Wi-Fi firmware (rtw88)
drivers.summary: A newer version of the RTL8821C, RTL8822B and RTL8822C firmware than the one in the system, with Realtek's fixes since.
drivers.description: Phoenix comes with this firmware; this is a newer release from linux-firmware. It is installed beside the system's (in /lib/firmware/updates, which the kernel reads first), so removing it goes back to the system's.

license.name: Realtek firmware licence
license.text:
Sample catalog: this stands for the licence text the real entry carries,
linux-firmware's LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt (Copyright (c) 2010, Realtek
Semiconductor Corporation), shown in full before installing. In short, it
allows passing the firmware on in binary form, unmodified, with Realtek's
copyright notice and disclaimer; it does not allow reverse engineering,
decompiling or disassembling it, or using Realtek's name to promote
products; and it gives no warranty.

Read the full text at:
https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/firmware/linux-firmware.git/tree/LICENCE.rtlwifi_firmware.txt

drivers.title: Realtek RTL8812AU Wi-Fi driver
drivers.summary: A driver for USB Wi-Fi adapters with the RTL8812AU or RTL8821AU chip, which the system's Linux 6.6 kernel does not include.
drivers.description: Open source (GPL-2.0), maintained outside the Linux kernel by the aircrack-ng project, built for each Phoenix kernel (meta-phoenix, rtl8812au). Linux 6.14 and later drive these adapters themselves (rtw88); Phoenix never installs this over a driver the kernel has.

drivers.title: Realtek RTL8814AU Wi-Fi driver
drivers.summary: A driver for USB Wi-Fi adapters with the RTL8814AU chip (four antennas), which the system's Linux 6.6 kernel does not include.
drivers.description: Open source (GPL-2.0), maintained by Nick Morrow (morrownr/8814au), built for each Phoenix kernel (meta-phoenix, rtl8814au).
